title: 每个星期五留一桌  (A Table Every Friday)

segments.t: After the applause settles into happy conversation, Hao and Peng sit at a small courtyard table under the tree as Mei brings out warm cinnamon rolls. Let's listen in first.
两份热乎乎的肉桂卷，送给我最棒的做汤烤面包搭档！
小美，坐下一分钟吧——志豪有大消息要告诉我们。
等等——志豪，别告诉我你星期六早上的火车取消了！
比那更好：我坐那趟火车，只是回去收拾箱子搬回来。
老弟，快告诉小美你今天下午在梧桐巷签了什么！
过了面包店再走四家门，有一间空着的一楼工作室。
不会吧！你要在我们这条街上开声学设计工作室？！
白天我画安静的房间，志鹏从市政厅下班就带爷爷的木工工具过来！
晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
那每个星期五六点，院子里这张桌子我都留给你们俩！
小美，快用不掉色的钢笔写进老陈的纸本子里！
从星期一拿错蓝色行李箱，变成一辈子的好邻居！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
两份热乎乎的肉桂卷，送给我最棒的做汤烤面包搭档！

'Two warm cinnamon rolls as my gift for my best soup-and-bread crew!' Adding "-huhu" onto "re", "hot", makes "rehuhu"—gentle, comforting bakery warmth rather than scalding heat. And "song gei" always means giving something free as a gift.
小美，坐下一分钟吧——志豪有大消息要告诉我们。
'Sit down for a minute, Mei—Hao has big news to tell us.' Putting "yi fenzhong", "one minute", right after "sit down" is how Mandarin naturally measures how long an action lasts.
等等——志豪，别告诉我你星期六早上的火车取消了！

'Wait—don't tell me your Saturday morning train was cancelled, Hao!' Mandarin calls a train "huoche", literally "fire-vehicle" from steam-engine days, and "quxiao" is the everyday word you see on station boards for "cancelled".
比那更好：我坐那趟火车，只是回去收拾箱子搬回来。

'Better: I am only taking that train to pack my boxes and move back.' Watch "huila" versus "huiqu" in one sentence: "huiqu" goes back away from Chengdu to pack, and "ban huilai" moves back home toward the speaker!
老弟，快告诉小美你今天下午在梧桐巷签了什么！

'Tell Mei what you signed on Wutong Lane this afternoon, little brother!' Peng calls Hao "laodi", literally "old younger-brother"—in Mandarin, prefix "lao-" adds warm brotherly affection rather than age.
过了面包店再走四家门，有一间空着的一楼工作室。
'There was an empty ground-floor studio four doors past the bakery.' In Mandarin, "yi lou", "floor one", always means the ground floor right at street level.
不会吧！你要在我们这条街上开声学设计工作室？！

'No way! You are opening your acoustic design studio on our street?!' Long winding things like streets, lanes, and rivers take the counter "tiao", and "kai"—"open"—works just like English for launching a studio or shop.
白天我画安静的房间，志鹏从市政厅下班就带爷爷的木工工具过来！

'By day I draw quiet rooms, and after City Hall Peng brings Grandfather's wood tools!' "Baitian", "white-sky", means daytime, and "xiaban"—literally "step down from shift"—is the everyday word for getting off work.
晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
'Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and panels together!' "Geyin" explains itself at a glance: "block-off" plus "sound" gives "soundproofing".
那每个星期五六点，院子里这张桌子我都留给你们俩！

'Then I am reserving this exact courtyard table for you two every Friday at six!' Whenever Mandarin says "meige", "every", look out for partner "dou" later in the sentence sealing the promise: "every Friday, without fail".
小美，快用不掉色的钢笔写进老陈的纸本子里！
'Put it in Chen's paper book in permanent ink, Mei!' "Bu diaose" literally says "never drops colour"—fade-proof permanent ink—written with a "gangbi", "steel-nib pen".
从星期一拿错蓝色行李箱，变成一辈子的好邻居！
'From a swapped blue suitcase on Monday to neighbours for good!' "Nacuo" recalls the "take-wrong" suitcase mix-up from Episode One, and "yibeizi"—"one lifetime"—is the warmest way to say "for good".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
两份热乎乎的肉桂卷，送给我最棒的做汤烤面包搭档！
小美，坐下一分钟吧——志豪有大消息要告诉我们。
等等——志豪，别告诉我你星期六早上的火车取消了！
比那更好：我坐那趟火车，只是回去收拾箱子搬回来。
老弟，快告诉小美你今天下午在梧桐巷签了什么！

不会吧！你要在我们这条街上开声学设计工作室？！

晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
那每个星期五六点，院子里这张桌子我都留给你们俩！
小美，快用不掉色的钢笔写进老陈的纸本子里！
从星期一拿错蓝色行李箱，变成一辈子的好邻居！
Two brothers who barely spoke two weeks ago now share a studio project right down Wutong Lane—with a standing Friday table under the tree! See you next time.
下次见！
